meta.title: cinis
meta.description: Share secrets that self-destruct after one read.

footer.note: Encryption happens in your browser. The server never receives the key.

create.heading: Share a one-time secret
create.secret_support: Encrypted in your browser; the server stores only the ciphertext. The URL is destroyed after a single read.
create.expires_support: If nobody opens it in time, the server deletes it automatically.
create.result_note: Send this URL to the recipient. It opens only once.

reveal.no_key_body: This URL is missing the decryption key (the part after #). Paste the full URL you received, including the end.
reveal.gone_body: It has been read once, or it has expired. Ask the sender for a new one if you still need it.
reveal.ready_title: A secret is waiting for you
reveal.ready_body: Once revealed, it is permanently deleted from the server. You will not be able to open this URL again.
reveal.destroyed_note: It has been deleted from the server. Save it now if you need it.
reveal.error_body: The key does not match this URL, or the request failed.
